meta.name: gemini-agents-api
meta.description: Manages custom Agent resources on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Use when the user wants to programmatically create, configure, list, update, or delete stateful, server-managed Agent resources (including mounting files, skills, and tools) before executing conversations.

copy.tagline: 编程管理 Gemini 企业 Agent 资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Gemini 平台上用代码管理 Agent 资源
copy.tagline_en: Manage Gemini enterprise agent resources programmatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Agent resources on Gemini platform via code

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能通过REST API在Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform上创建、查看、更新和删除自定义Agent资源，包括挂载文件、技能和工具。
howto.when: 当用户想用编程方式管理Gemini Agent Platform上的自定义Agent资源（如创建、配置、列出、更新或删除）时触发。

say.text: 列出我项目下所有自定义Agent。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to programmatically create, get, list, update, and delete custom Agent resources on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform via REST API, including mounting files, skills, and tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to programmatically manage custom Agent resources on the Gemini Agent Platform, such as creating, configuring, listing, updating, or deleting agents.

say_en.text: Create an agent named my-custom-agent using the antigravity-preview-05-2026 base model.
say_en.note: Claude will send a POST request to create the agent.

say_en.text: List all custom agents in my project.
say_en.note: Claude will call the List Agents API.

say_en.text: Update my-custom-agent's system instruction to 'You are a telecom support agent'.
say_en.note: Claude will use a PATCH request.
